title: PaginatedCommunicationList
description: Paginated response for GET /communications. F0021-S0004. Default page size is 25 (max 100). Feed appends on 'Load earlier' click — page increments, results are client-merged.

data.description: Communication events for the current page, sorted by occurredAt descending.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Default 25.

totalCount.description: Total number of communication events for the entity (unpaged).

totalPages.description: Total number of pages given the current pageSize.
